newsitem.title: UK: Dixons says has no market power in retail parks.
newsitem.headline: Dixons says has no market power in retail parks.

text.p: Electrical retailer Dixons Plc on Tuesday responded to a report that it could face an inquiry over alleged tactics to have rivals excluded from new retail parks, saying it had "absolutely no market power" in such developments.
In a statement, Dixons said the market for space in new retail parks was highly competitive and each developer was free to decide to whom it lets its space and on what terms.

Earlier a report in the Times said the OFT could launch a formal enquiry, after complaints by rivals that the company had used an unfair and anti-competitive strategy to force developers to deny them floorspace.
Dixons shares were down 12p at 484 by 1040 GMT in volume of 1.8 million shares, not far from their year's low of 474p set on February 4.
